requirements.requirement: Create the appworker account on node1.
requirements.summary: The account was absent initially, then existed with UID/GID 1000, home /home/appworker, and shell /bin/bash. Its account and home remained present after restart.

requirements.requirement: Give appworker login sessions a limit of 8,192 open files and 256 processes.
requirements.summary: A PAM-backed appworker login session directly reported soft and hard limits of 8,192 open files and 256 processes. The persistent policy and effective limits were verified again after restart.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied. Fixed lifecycle boot observations independently corroborate that transition.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified.
